name: Director of Technical Solutions
focus: Owns the Technical Solutions desk. Asks whether every accepted stream has an outlet with capacity, where new volume should go, and what goes to the Capacity Committee.

name: Vice President, Sales (Capacity Committee chair)
focus: Chairs the Capacity Committee and signs contracts above $2M. Asks what a proposal earns, what capacity it rests on, and how revenue compares with the plan.

name: Account Manager
focus: Owns the generator relationship. Asks what a stream will be priced at, which facility it goes to, what the customer requires, and how long the quote takes.

name: Approval Chemist
focus: Approves profiles at a facility. Asks whether a waste is understood, whether its codes are on the permit for the unit, and what the laboratory released.

name: Plant Manager, Incineration
focus: Runs an incinerator. Asks what is booked against the unit's capacity, what headroom is left, and what an outage strands.

name: Customer Solutions Coordinator
focus: Runs a service center. Asks which shipments are on the pad, how long, and where each one goes next.

name: Director of Compliance
focus: Owns permits and compliance. Asks which permits are up for renewal, which conditions bind a routing, and whether a generator can ship.

name: Pricing and Margin Manager
focus: Owns the price book and the floor. Asks what each stream earns on full cost, which contracts are under the floor, and what a fee change does.

name: Laboratory Manager
focus: Runs the laboratory. Asks which results are released, which profiles wait on a result, and where the lab and the profile disagree.

name: Transportation Manager
focus: Moves the waste. Asks what a re-route costs on the rate card, which lanes carry the most tons, and what trucks are needed.

name: Third-Party Approvals Lead
focus: Keeps the outside outlets approved. Asks which approvals expire, what the outlets cost, and which streams depend on them.

name: Landfill Program Manager
focus: Runs the secure landfill. Asks what arrives stabilized and compliant, and how much airspace the bookings use.

name: Business President
focus: Runs one of the three businesses. Asks what the business earns, at which facilities, and how it compares with the plan.

name: Chief Financial Officer
focus: Asks revenue against plan, margin by business and facility, and what third-party outlets cost.

name: Internal Audit
focus: Tests the acceptance and pricing controls. Asks how many profiles were approved on unreleased results and how many quotes went below the book.

name: Integration Lead, Acquisitions
focus: Brings the acquired companies in. Asks how many profiles are still on the legacy system and which have been reviewed.

name: Environmental Health and Safety Manager
focus: Keeps receipts safe. Asks which generators send off-spec loads and which discrepancies repeat.
